title: roland-sysex-map/v0
description: A Roland addressed-SysEx (DT1/RQ1) parameter map that carries, per entry, where the entry came from and whether hardware has confirmed it. Written for the FP-30X, but nothing here is FP-30X specific.

notice.description: Affiliation and confidence disclaimer, travelling with the data.

examples.description: Frames quoted from a source, so a validator can re-derive their checksums instead of trusting the quote.

hex.description: 7-bit bytes as hex, optionally space separated.

address.description: A four-byte Roland parameter address, every byte 7-bit.

identity_word.description: A two-byte Universal Identity family or member code.

frame.description: A complete F0..F7 frame as hex, optionally space separated. Both ends are required: a frame quoted without its terminator is a fragment, and a validator that accepts fragments is describing a different format than the one tools read.

checksum.description: Roland's one-byte checksum over address plus payload.

corroborations.description: Independent efforts reporting the same constants. Weaker than a measurement, and kept apart from one.

allOf.$comment: Raw bytes have no single numeric value, so naming or bounding them would describe something that does not exist.

encoding.description: u7: one 7-bit byte. u14: two 7-bit bytes, most significant first. raw: bytes with no single numeric meaning.

enum.description: The whole known value space, when the values have names. Keys are decimal values with no leading zeros, so that every reader parses them the same way.

verify_with.description: Parameter to read back after writing this one, when the write address cannot be read.

source.description: official_doc: the manufacturer's published implementation. app_re: reverse engineering of the manufacturer's app. panel_capture: seen on the wire when the panel was used.

verified.description: Hardware confirmations. Empty means unverified hypothesis.

verification.description: Scoped to one firmware revision and one unit: a single instrument cannot speak for the model.

firmware.description: Software revision from the device's Identity Reply.
